title: Prompt Engineering Masterclass: Get Expert Results from Any AI
subtitle: Go beyond casual chatting. Write, test and reuse prompts that get reliable, professional-grade results from ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
description:
You already use ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, but the results are hit and miss. Some answers are brilliant; others are generic, too long, or quietly wrong. This course turns casual prompting into a dependable professional skill you can use every working day and show on your CV.

You will learn the anatomy of a great prompt, when to use examples, how to ask for step-by-step reasoning, and how to get clean tables, JSON and checklists. You will then move to reliability: reducing hallucinations by grounding answers in your own documents, chaining prompts for multi-step work, and testing prompts against real cases so you know they work before you share them.

The second half is about real work and scale: prompts for writing, analysis, data extraction, coding help and image generation, configuring custom assistants for a job role, building a tested prompt library for your team, and using AI safely, including awareness of prompt injection and data privacy.

Every lesson is short, practical and written with Indian workplaces in mind, and ends with a hands-on exercise. By the end you will have four portfolio projects: a 25-prompt professional library, a meeting-notes-to-client-report chain, a tested data-extraction prompt, and a custom assistant for a specific role.
audience: Regular ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini users who want consistent, professional-quality output
Marketers, analysts and consultants who use AI for client and business work
Teachers and trainers who want reliable lesson, assessment and communication prompts
Aspiring developers and technical learners who want to use AI for coding help
Job seekers who want genuine, demonstrable prompt engineering skills on their CV

Use few-shot examples and templates to get consistent output in your house style
Get clean tables, JSON and checklists you can paste straight into Sheets or other tools
Reduce hallucinations by grounding answers in your documents and allowing 'I don't know'

Access to at least one AI chat assistant (a free plan is enough for most exercises)

Create a four-step prompt chain that turns raw meeting notes into a client-ready report and cover email.

faqs.q: I already use ChatGPT. Will this course actually teach me something new?
faqs.a: Yes, it is designed for people who already use AI casually. The focus is on reliability and professional use: structured prompts, grounding to reduce hallucinations, prompt chaining, testing prompts with real cases, custom assistants and team prompt libraries.

faqs.q: Do I need a paid ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini plan?
faqs.a: No. Most exercises work on free plans. Some features, such as creating custom assistants or uploading many files, may need a paid plan depending on the tool, and the lessons show a workaround when a feature isn't available to you.

faqs.q: Do I need to know coding?
faqs.a: No. There is one lesson on using AI for coding help, and it is written so non-programmers can follow it for spreadsheet formulas and small scripts. Everything else needs no technical background.

faqs.q: Will this course get me a prompt engineering job?
faqs.a: We can't promise a job or a salary. What you will have is a genuine, practical skill and four portfolio projects you can show to employers or clients, which makes your AI experience concrete and credible on your CV and LinkedIn.
Yes. A certificate of completion is issued when you mark every lesson in the course as complete. You can add it to your LinkedIn profile and CV.
You can get a full refund within 7 days of purchase as long as you have completed less than 30% of the course. Just contact support with your order details.
